name: LINE_OA_SAFE_AUTOMATION_DRY_RUN_WORKFLOW

parameters.content: SAFE DRY RUN ONLY. This workflow prepares a sample LINE OA scheduled post packet for review. It does not call LINE API, does not contain tokens, and must stay inactive until human approval and credential governance are complete.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { mode: "DRY_RUN_ONLY", platform: "LINE_OA", scheduled_date: "YYYY-MM-DD", scheduled_time: "20:30", review_status: "PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW", publish_allowed: false, title: "Sample LINE OA title for dry-run", main_text: "Sample reviewed copy goes here. Use only local舒緩, 按摩放鬆, 暫時舒緩, 日常保養 language.", cta: "查看今日保養提醒", forbidden_actions: ["NO_LINE_API_CALL", "NO_TOKEN", "NO_AUTO_PUBLISH", "NO_LOGIN"], next_step: "Export CSV or send to human review queue only" } }];

const item = $input.first().json; const forbidden = ["治療","根治","消炎治本","修復軟骨","消除骨刺","治療椎間盤突出","治療神經痛","打通經絡","排毒","保證有效","一擦就好","神奇","特效"]; const text = `${item.title || ""}\n${item.main_text || ""}`; const hits = forbidden.filter(term => text.includes(term)); return [{ json: { ...item, compliance_status: hits.length === 0 ? "PASS_FOR_DRY_RUN" : "NEEDS_REWRITE", forbidden_term_hits: hits, final_action: "WRITE_REVIEW_QUEUE_ONLY_DO_NOT_PUBLISH" } }];

return $input.all().map(item => ({ json: { ...item.json, output_destination: "AI_MARKETING_TEAM/06_REVIEW_QUEUE/PENDING_REVIEW.md or CSV manual export", line_api_called: false, posted_to_line: false, workflow_result: "DRY_RUN_COMPLETE_NO_EXTERNAL_ACTION" } }));
